text:
sam: Heads-up: seeing a sustained spike in WS reconnects from mobile SDKs after the "ephemeral-resume" rollout in eu-west. Clients reconnecting repeatedly and some users report duplicated messages.

tori: console alert flagged route `cost-eu` ~2% reconnect rate, token usage +4% for a small tenant slice.

sam: reproducer: long-lived chat on flaky cellular -> after ~45s idle client gets a partial frame then reopens.

diego: any gateway logs?

sam: yup, stack from gateway: 
```
[gw] accept: conn_id=abc123 from 10.2.1.5
[gw] header: Resume-Hint: "eyJ2IjoyfQ=="  # base64 for {"v":2}
[gw] parse_error: invalid_resume_hint unsupported_version=2 -> drop_resume
[gw] client reconnect: new_session id=xyz456 trace=trace-42
```

lin: "v2"? we didn't publicize v2 to clients yet. we only added an enum change in the routing proto.

tori: control-plane rollout enabled `resume_policy=EPHEMERAL` on the cost route as part of the cost-saver canary yesterday.

diego: older gateway binary + mobile SDK treat unknown enum/format as fatal parse error? I thought protobuf unknown enums map to 0.

lin: detail: server now emits a structured Resume-Hint payload with a version field and optional ephemeral token. new gateways accept v2, fall back to v1. older gateways don't have the fallback path and surface parse_error -> gateway drops resume semantics and forces new session. mobile SDKs also validate the hint and then abandon resume attempt when invalid.

sam: so with mixed fleet (new control plane + mixed gateways + older SDKs) we get asymmetric behaviour: some connections get resume accepted, others create fresh sessions -> clients attempt resume -> fail -> immediate reopen -> duplicate session creation and extra token billing.

console-bot: incident INC-8151 created by @sre-bot for websocket reopen surge.
sre-bot: paging @oncall-eng-platform. severity P2.

tori: mitigation options: 1) revert resume_policy change in control plane (fast) 2) push compatibility shim to gateways to accept/ignore unknown v2 (slower) 3) hotfix SDKs (nope). prefer revert + shim.

lin: agreed. revert done. control-plane config back to `resume_policy=LEGACY` for cost-eu.

diego: I'll prepare a small gateway patch to be liberal in parsing Resume-Hint and fallback to v1 semantics when unknown fields present. rolling that to canary now. estimated 30m.

billing-bot: note: billing telemetry shows ~1.7% session creation spike during the incident window; filing dedupe task: if session_start detected within 2s of a previous closed session and same client_trace, mark as potential duplicate and hold meter until confirm.

sam: good. console: can we bump resume_hint parse error sampling? current sample is 0.05% and we need full traces for debugging.

tori: doing that now; also adding a temporary dashboard tile for `resume_hint_parse_errors` and `resume_success_rate` by route.

lin: followups: 1) add explicit compatibility gate for any change to the resume payload that requires consumers to support new version before control-plane flips route default 2) CI: run gateway+sdk compatibility matrix on proto version changes 3) telemetry: tag session_open with `resume_protocol_version` and `routing_policy_hash` so we can map which path served which client.

diego: I'll own the gateway compatibility shim + canary test.

tori: I'll own the telemetry and dashboard work.

sam: I'll own the postmortem and console rollout guard change.

console-bot: rollout guard: new checkbox for "compatibility-tested" added to the UI for protocol-changing toggles.

sam: monitoring after revert shows reconnect rate back to baseline. billing team to confirm no lingering double-billing.

billing-bot: billing delta looks like a short blip, we will apply protective credit if any customer affected. filing follow-up billing-ticket BL-332.

lin: longer term: treat proto additions as "versioned extension" and add runtime handshake version negotiation rather than relying on opaque hints.

diego: adding integration test for resume v1<->v2 negotiation to the canary pipeline. also emitting richer logs when parse_error occurs with route hash and gateway binary version.

sam: thanks everyone. we avoided a wider outage since revert was quick. postmortem scheduled tomorrow 9:30 in #eng-postmortems.

tori: closing incident once gateway patch is in canary and billing confirms. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: incident INC-8151 status -> monitoring.
